overall.verdict: A visually coherent, trust-forward dark wallet whose green/violet guarantee-vs-promise model is genuinely differentiated and mostly legible. Its weaknesses are protocol jargon leaking into consumer screens (entity id, frames, capacity, basis points), repeated unexplained color bars, and several CTA/overlap and disabled-state problems on bottom-sheet variants.
priority_fixes: Replace all protocol vocabulary (entity id, frame, capacity, account route, basis points) with plain language across Receive, Ownership, Activity detail, Lend
Annotate every green/violet bar with segment values and a scale reference; desaturate zero-balance legend swatches
Compute and surface unsecured exposure (promised minus collateral) as an explicit risk row on Account screens
Fix bottom-sheet layout defects: overlapping CTAs (Move, Swap, Lend), clipped cards (Sovereignty, Assets), and dim backgrounds behind receipt sheets
Give every disabled primary button an inline reason and separate destructive actions (Forget vault, Dispute) from daily actions
